contracts.declared_mechanism: Pending-request registry _pending_permission_request_ids (claude_process.py:54), populated only by _emit_permission_request from CLI stream payload request IDs (claude_process.py:1855-1860) and cleared at run start (claude_process.py:147); send_permission_response normalizes the action into a fixed payload (allow/deny sentinel or non-empty comment text), snapshots registry, running, and stop state under self._lock, and returns False without writing unless request_id is pending, the process is running and not stop-requested, process and process.stdin are non-None, and process.poll() is None; the matched request id is discarded after the write (single-use, claude_process.py:136-138).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Writing an approval/denial/comment payload to the CLI subprocess stdin when the request_id is empty, is not present in _pending_permission_request_ids, the run is not running or stop was requested, the process handle or its stdin is None, or process.poll() is not None (stale, duplicate, or unmatched approval payloads reaching the tool-executing CLI).

contracts.protected_operation: Delivery of a human permission decision (allow/deny/comment) to the running provider CLI subprocess in response to a CLI-emitted tool permission request.
contracts.protected_resource: The stdin stream of the live provider CLI subprocess (claude/codex/gemini) that executes agent tools once approval is delivered.
contracts.protection_obligation: Permission responses (allow/deny/comment) for provider-CLI tool-execution prompts may only be written to the running provider CLI subprocess's stdin when the response's request_id matches a currently registered pending permission request for that live, un-stopped process; the stdin write in ClaudeProcess.send_permission_response is the guarded commit point.
scope_limits: Governs only the stdin approval channel of the currently running provider CLI process held by ClaudeProcess; responses for other processes, sessions, or already-finished runs are out of scope.
Comment-action responses are additionally gated on non-empty trimmed text (claude_process.py:99-103); comment content beyond non-emptiness is not constrained by this contract.
